note: Small notes pinned on the quay's noticeboard (I026 stage 02, HarbourNotes). Cozy local colour only: no quests, no rewards, nothing that replaces a weather or safety warning. A few are chosen per harbour and week, deterministically.

notices.text: Fresh bread in the mornings while it lasts.
Found on the pontoon: a blue fender with a white line. Ask at the harbour office.
Choir practice in the old net loft on Thursday evenings. All voices welcome.
Please walk slowly on the pontoons: the boards are slippery when wet.
The sailing club's dinghies are out on Saturday mornings. Keep a lookout in the fairway.
For sale: a pair of oars, well used, still good.
The harbour's flower boxes are looked after by volunteers. Thank you for leaving them be.
Lost: a child's red mitten, somewhere near the café.
Fishing from the quay is welcome away from the walkway and the travel lift.
Market on the square on the first Saturday of the month.
Fresh water at every pontoon. Please close the taps.
Thank you to everyone who helped haul out the old harbour launch.
